description.sr: Sredinom novembra, 19. novembra 1942. godine, sovjetske snage pod generalima Vatutinom, Rokosovskim i Jeremenkom pokreću operaciju Uran, veliku kontraofanzivu koja zatvara klin i opkoljava nemačku Šestu armiju kod Staljingrada.
description.en: In mid-November, on November 19, 1942, Soviet forces under Generals Vatutin, Rokossovsky and Yeremenko launched Operation Uranus, a major counteroffensive that closed the pincer and encircled the German Sixth Army at Stalingrad.

events.quote: tu čuvenu sovjetsku kontraofanzivu, zatvaranje klina, sredina novembra, 19. novembar

title.en: Stalingrad as the turning point of the war

description.sr: Nakon poraza kod Staljingrada, nemački vojnici, sve verniji nacional-socijalizmu do samog kraja, počinju da razmišljaju o porazu; bitka postaje simbol koji je utkan u modernu Rusiju, posleratnu Evropu i Sjedinjene Države.
description.en: After the defeat at Stalingrad, German soldiers, loyal to National Socialism until the very end, began to consider the possibility of defeat; the battle became a symbol woven into modern Russia, postwar Europe, and the United States.

events.quote: prekretnica svakako, veliki događaj, velika bitka
